items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I haven’t had the pleasure of playing with Herbie Hancock yet.

ctx.x: You’ve done more playing duo with piano players than anybody else I know. Not only with him of course but with literally too many piano players to mention, but lots of really great ones.
I haven’t had the pleasure of playing with Herbie Hancock yet. I would like to do that once.
